description: A long time ago, lived 8 celestials, Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, Light, Nature, Darkness and Aether

Everthing was alright in the Astral Plane until the dastardly Voidex approached the very crystal that keeps the Astral Plane stable and shattered it. He tried to absorb the fragments, but was stopped by the celestials.
To make sure that Voidex wouldn't do the same thing again, the celestials used their powers to seal him away. But in the process all but the light celestial vanished mysteriously.
The followers of Voidex where enraged, and began their mission to bring back Voidex for him to continue on his work.
Now it is up to Luna, Stratix and the Light Celestial to bring back the other celestials and prevent Voidex from collecting all the fragments and bring back order in the Astral Plane!
